summary_bullets: Changed /upgrade-larch cache-cap pruning to sort cache directories by mtime with a deterministic version-basename tiebreaker while preserving existing stable and active-session pins.
Added a shared cache-root touch helper and wired it into session setup plus both session-env writers so actively used numeric cache roots stay recent.
Expanded prune and session-env harnesses to cover mtime ordering, stat fallback, equal-mtime tiebreaks, and numeric-versus-non-numeric cache-root touch behavior.
Updated upgrade, session-env, installation, and security documentation for the new mtime-based retention model.
commit_message:
Keep /upgrade-larch cache retention mtime-based

Retain cached larch versions by directory mtime instead of semver order, and refresh the executing numeric cache root during session setup and session-env writes. Add regression coverage for mtime pruning, stat fallback, and cache-root touch behavior.
